subject: general
question: In the passage, one plant is characterised not only by its ornamental value but also by a functional benefit derived from a substance within its leaves, which is esteemed for dermal amelioration. Which plant fits this description?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Functional and Ornamental Value:** The passage explicitly identifies **Aloe vera** as an exemplar that offers more than just aesthetic appeal. While it is used for "ornamental utility," it also "confers medicinal benefits."
 
• **Dermal Amelioration:** The text specifies that the **gel** found within the succulent leaves of the Aloe vera is "esteemed for dermal amelioration," which refers to the improvement or healing of the skin.
 
• **Analysis of Other Plants:** 
 
 
• **Snake plant:** Praised for "structural elegance" and being "indomitable."
 
• **Pothos:** Characterized by "luxuriant, trailing foliage."
 
• **ZZ plant:** Described as appearing "sculpted from emerald wax" and flourishing in neglect.
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amelioration:** A formal term meaning the act of making something better or improving it. In this context, it refers to skin care or healing.
 
• **Superfluous:** The passage notes that the Aloe vera’s ability to store moisture makes frequent irrigation "superfluous," meaning unnecessary or redundant.
 
• **Ancillary:** The author concludes that in growing these plants, human oversight is "ancillary" (secondary), as the plants' own mechanisms ensure their survival.
